newsitem.title: UK: Shell says Brent Charlie restarts after shutdown.
newsitem.headline: Shell says Brent Charlie restarts after shutdown.

text.p: Shell U.K. Exploration and Production (Shell Expro) said its North Sea Brent Charlie platform resumed production early on Monday after lengthy maintenance.
Shell said production would gradually build up to reach 80,000 bpd before the end of the year.

"Resumption of oil production from Brent Charlie -- only six and a half months after initial shutdown -- is yet another major milestone for the overall 1.3 billion (stg) Brent Field redevelopment project," said Brent Field General Manager Walter Van de Vijver.
"Work on Brent Charlie is being completed within budget and ahead of schedule," he added.
Shell Expro is a joint venture between Royal Dutch/Shell and Exxon.
Commissioning activities will continue to allow start-up of gas exports from the platform during November and final work is expected to be completed by the end of the year, Shell said.
